summary: Feed s059_single to IDS is degraded due to tool overload: 1.61 Gbps microbursts exceed 1 Gbps IDS port capacity (161%, 6 intervals). All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering unconditioned bursts to a single 1 Gbps IDS port with no load-balancing or burst shaping. Peak 1.61 Gbps in 1ms intervals is 161% of port capacity, causing sustained over-subscription across 6 intervals.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS ingress buffers overrun and packets are dropped before inspection. IDS cannot reassemble flows or match signatures reliably, creating blind spots and missed detections despite needing full payload and bidirectional traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic with 5-tuple hashing across 2+ IDS ports to keep per-port utilization below 80% threshold and absorb 1.61 Gbps bursts without drops, preserving full payload for detection.
